analysis:
Reviewed both primary analyses and all replayed patches, metadata and source. The removals are console-specific: executable Git hooks ran console ESLint/build checks; .github/dependabot.yml base:3–4 targeted only /console-ui; .github/workflows/ci.yml base:37 and 637–658 remove console routing and lint/test/build. The matching reusable-workflow console outputs are removed in .github/workflows/component-changes.yml base:8–9 and 22. Its provider output, read-only permissions and credential-free checkout remain visible at head:6–24. Thus the supplied caller and output removals are consistent, rather than evidence of a broken provider gate.
AGENTS.md head:5 and CONTRIBUTING.md head:19–20 describe platform console ownership; their other changes remove local console validation and telemetry-mirror guidance. Documentation alone does not establish source or hosting retirement. These changes do not themselves alter provider request authorization, attestation, encryption, plaintext handling, cache isolation, billing or privileged/local-hold controls under TB-002/003/007/010/011/012 and related threats. No concrete security regression is independently supported; removing general lint/build checks is not sufficient evidence of an exploitable weakness.
Remaining material question: is console-ui actually retired from this repository's maintained/buildable/hosted artifacts, or does a retained artifact lose dependency-security automation and tests? Confirm the PR's console source/build/hosting disposition and any remaining callers of the removed console output. Replay omits 11 reviewed units and does not include that disposition or classifier implementation, so the local questions cannot be fully resolved here. This is a coverage limit, not proof of unsafe deployment or a demand to audit platform internals. Only indexed and selected canonical definitions were supplied.
